summary: serialize_bytes omitted the varint length prefix expected by deserialize_bytes, causing payload bytes to be interpreted as a length and producing incorrect results or deserialization errors. The fix writes the length before the payload using a direct varint helper that avoids recursive serialization. Reversing only this prefix insertion restores the bug. The regression case added to de::test_heapless::bytes explicitly calls serialize_bytes through ByteSliceStruct and expects 33 encoded bytes for a 32-byte payload; the reversal produces 32. No tests were run.
